newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Iran decries "savage aggression" against Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Iran decries "savage aggression" against Zaire.

text.p: Iran, decrying "savage aggression" against Zaire, has offered its good offices for a peaceful resolution of the rebel war in eastern Zaire, Voice of Zaire radio said on Wednesday.

"Iran will do its best to put an end to the savage aggression against the sovereign state of Zaire. Zaire's situation is tragic," the state radio quoted Iran's charge d'affaires in Kinshasa, Reza Rezvald Ali, as saying.
Without giving a context for the remarks, the radio said:
"Iran accepted on Saturday to mediate in the conflict between Zaire and its eastern neighbours."
Zaire accuses Rwanda, Burundi and Uganda of helping ethnic Tutsi rebels who launched an armed campaign in October and have seized a vast border area.
Zaire has ruled out dialogue with the rebels, saying it is preparing its retreatig army for a counter-offensive to retake seized territory.

Moslem Iran has recently been trying to raise its profile in Africa and President Ali Akhbar Hashemi Rafsanjani mediated in a dispute between Uganda and Islamist Sudan during a rare tour of the continent last year.
